text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following treatment for acute sinusitis. Can you describe the severity and location of your flank pain, and have you noticed any changes in your urination?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any burning or pain when you urinate, and have you noticed any blood in your urine? Also, is the flank pain on one side or both?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you develop any joint pain, abdominal pain, or swelling in your hands and feet during or after taking the cephalexin? Also, have you noticed any dark or cola-colored urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of a rash with amoxicillin followed by fever and flank pain after switching to cephalexin, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis. REQUEST TEST: Serum Creatinine.
